messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> billing-usage-lag (P1)

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident 98127 - billing-usage-lag - P1
Summary: Usage metering pipeline lagging, token counts not closing, potential invoice blockers for customers.
Runbook: run billing/usage triage steps, notify billing & support, consider manual invoice generation.

oncall-sre: acked. I'm on it. Paging eng-runtime and billing.

maria-lee: @oncall-sre thanks. Do we know scope/which customers affected?

support-jordan: We already have 8 inbound tickets and 4 open CS escalations flagged as invoice-blocker. Top affected customers: AcmeAnalytics, KauriHealth, BrightCart (tickets #5401 #5402 #5403). They can't retrieve final invoices.

billing-eng-bot: Observed backlog in aggregator queue. Current queue depth: 87, avg processing time 120s. Errors: intermittent 502 from tokenizer service. Sample log:```
2026-03-14T09:12:03Z ERROR aggregator.process - Failed to hydrate usage shard 42: 502 from tokenizer-service - "Bad Request"
2026-03-14T09:12:05Z WARN aggregator.requeue - shard 42 requeued (attempt 3)
2026-03-14T09:12:30Z ERROR billing.writer - write timeout to metering-db (timeout=5s)
```

alex-cheng: I can try a manual rerun of the nightly aggregator for the affected window (2026-03-13 00:00 to 2026-03-14 09:00). Will run in staging first then prod if green. Command:```sh
kubectl -n billing exec deploy/agg-worker -- /bin/sh -c "python /srv/agg/run_agg.py --start '2026-03-13T00:00:00Z' --end '2026-03-14T09:00:00Z' --shard 42"
```

samir-patel: quick note — tokenizer-service got a deploy 07:30 that changed default token normalization; in dev we saw token count drift ~+15% for certain payloads. If that's hitting aggregator it could explain miscounts and DB write strain. Pulling diff now.```diff
- normalize_tokens = False
+ normalize_tokens = True
```

oncall-sre: samir, can you rollback tokenizer deploy if that's likely root cause? We need to decide fast (customers blocked).

samir-patel: rolling back now. ETA ~3m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty -> escalation triggered: routed to eng-runtime escalation policy.

billing-eng-bot: rollback applied, tokenizer-service back to v2.14.5, healthchecks passing. Observed reduction in 502s.

alex-cheng: rerunning aggregator in prod now (after staging smoke):
```sh
# prod run
kubectl -n billing exec deploy/agg-worker -- /bin/sh -c "python /srv/agg/run_agg.py --start '2026-03-13T00:00:00Z' --end '2026-03-14T09:00:00Z' --shard 42 --force"
```

billing-eng-bot: prod run accepted, processing shards 40-45. Progress: 40% (approx 46m remaining). Queue depth decreasing to 21.

support-jordan: Heads up — CS will start offering manual invoice exports to critical customers while we wait. Do we have script?

alex-cheng: yes: `tools/generate_invoices --customers AcmeAnalytics,KauriHealth,BrightCart --window 2026-03-13T00:00:00Z/2026-03-14T09:00:00Z --force`. I'll hand over to Jordan to run after I confirm processed records.

support-jordan: running manual invoice script now for the three customers (dry-run then commit). Will attach outputs to tickets.

billing-eng-bot: prod aggregation finished for shards 40-45. Final queue depth: 3. Post-run verification: token counts aligned with expected model; no double-counting detected after rollback.

maria-lee: customer impact summary for ops notes: ~12 customers impacted to varying degree, 3 customers blocked from invoice retrieval, estimated delayed invoices: ~150 invoices. CS is sending interim invoices.

oncall-sre: marking incident as mitigated. PagerDuty: set status -> acknowledged -> resolved once we confirm no further error spikes.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident 98127 status updated to "Mitigated" by oncall-sre at 1769201400.

support-jordan: manual invoices sent to AcmeAnalytics & BrightCart; KauriHealth requested CSV only, delivered. Customers notified, CS follow-up scheduled.

samir-patel: opening a PR to add a canary test for tokenizer normalization and revert guards to prevent autopromote without canary passing. PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2148

alex-cheng: we'll also add a short-term monitor to alert on token-count drift >10% per shard.

maria-lee: action items: 1) postmortem (owners: samir + alex), 2) add canary & monitor (samir), 3) customer outreach summary (support-jordan), 4) billing runbook update (billing-eng-bot).

oncall-sre: tagging for follow-up and closing pager now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty -> Incident 98127 marked resolved at 1769201500
